description: Emanuele Guerrazzi and Andrea Vandin publish a toolchain for automated vehicle storage and retrieval systems. A configurable MATLAB discrete-event simulator is coupled to MultiVeStA for repeated runs and statistical performance estimates. Event logs support process-mining analysis of bottlenecks, workload fairness and resource use. The described experiments compare four scenarios and storage or retrieval policies including random, deepest, nearest and AFB-ROR. Zenodo serves the August 2026 implementation as a ZIP archive free under CC BY 4.0. The authors report testing with MATLAB R2024b, Java 11 and Python 3; MATLAB availability and cost remain separate from the archive's licence. The tool models configurable warehouses without a fixed geographic or observation-period coverage. No simulation was rerun during this review. MultiVeStA is a named external dependency, but no related catalogue record was confirmed.
